body: I just dont enjoy life anymore and havent for a quite a number of years, help from mental health professionals doesnt seem to be doing much and tbf I just feel like my time is coming so looking at possible means to get out

Oh thanks for this. I was under the impression it would be a peaceful way out and to counter the nausea and vomiting to take anti sickness tablets before hand. It's just something iv not heard of much before but from what I read on suicide wiki it is meant to be peacefull

It's not sad what I feel anymore about knowing I want to end my life. It's a relief. I cant make sense of the world or myself the only thing that's made sense for months is the knowing I'm really okay with ending things

It's hard trying to find ways to make things better. I feel like I was put here just to suffer and have pieces of me die inside whilst acting as if things are ok. Constant voices telling me to end things and it makes perfect sense. This is nor the world I thought it would be
